documents.text: AUTH-401: A sign-in fails when the laptop clock differs by more than five minutes. Synchronize the device clock before signing in again.
AUTH.401: Company single sign-on fails after the identity provider certificate expires. An administrator must renew the certificate.
AUTH_401: The mobile sign-in screen loops when the browser blocks session cookies. Enable cookies for the application.
auth-401: An automation script receives unauthorized responses because its service token was revoked. Generate and install a new token.
BILL-12: A card can show two pending authorizations for one payment. The unused authorization normally disappears within seven days.
BILL-012: If a customer has two settled charges for the same invoice, support can investigate a duplicate-payment refund.
BILL_12: A recurring subscription payment fails when the saved card expires. Update the payment card and retry the invoice.
BILL.12: To include a missing tax identifier on a future invoice, update the billing profile before issuing the invoice.
SHIP-1.0: When a parcel is marked delivered but cannot be found, check with neighbors and open a delivery investigation after forty-eight hours.
SHIP-1_0: An order can remain at the warehouse before its first carrier scan. Allow two business days for the dispatch scan.
SHIP-10: The shipping address can be changed before the label is printed. Open the order and update the delivery address.
ship-1.0: An international shipment held at customs needs a commercial invoice. Upload the requested customs paperwork.
API-E500: A large batch request may exceed the API processing timeout. Split the payload into smaller batches.
API_E500: HTTP 429 indicates the API request rate limit was exceeded. Reduce request rate and retry with jittered backoff.
API.E500: A request signature can fail when the signed timestamp is wrong. Synchronize the client clock and sign the request again.
api-e500: Webhook signature verification fails if the JSON is reserialized before verification. Verify the raw request body instead.
